messages:
maria.docs: Quick heads-up — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842 is failing the docs preview (linkcheck + vale + spellcheck). I need to coordinate who picks which fix. I'm offline 14:00-16:00 PST.

devon: Can you paste the failing snippets from the preview?

maria.docs: Sure, here's the linkcheck output:
```
Linkcheck: Found broken anchor in /guides/migration.md: #old-auth -> not found
Linkcheck: 404: /sdk/python/examples/old-sample -> 404
```
and Vale summary:
```
ERROR: docs/style-rules/voice.yml: passive-voice: 3 occurrences (migration.md:45, snippets/setup.md:12)
```

sasha: I can take the link anchors. The migration page anchor moved when we renamed the section; I'll add a redirect or an explicit anchor. Will open a tiny commit.

chris: I can look at the Vale failures — I think the rule is flagging code comments as passive. I can scope the rule to ignore fenced code blocks or add a short inline `# vale: off` where appropriate.

ci-bot: preview build failed — linkcheck, vale, spellcheck. See https://deployments.redwood/dev/preview/842

maria.docs: thanks. plan: sasha — linkfix, chris — vale tweak, I'll scan the python SDK sample and fix the broken relative path. If we get green preview I need an approver before I head OOO. @anthony can you review after CI passes?

anthony: Yep I can review once CI is green. Ping me in the PR thread. If it's only anchor + lint fixes we can merge after one approval. Prefer to batch with a few tiny fixes so the deploy window isn't spammy; if green by 17:30 I'll merge.

devon: FYI the python sample path change will also affect the codegen example in /sdk/snippets.md — leave a note in the PR description about files touched.

sasha: PR update pushed: fixed anchor, added redirect comment. Linkcheck run locally -> passes.

ci-bot: preview build passed — all checks green.

maria.docs: Awesome. @anthony please review when you have a sec. If you approve I'll merge and cherry-pick the redirect for the stable branch.

anthony: Reviewing now.

anthony: Approved. Merge away :shipit: 

maria.docs: merged and backfilled a changelog entry. Thanks all :tada:
